results.caption: Soldiers with rifles gather on a muddy riverbank beside wooden boats and supply crates, likely Iran-Iraq War era photograph.
A historical black-and-white photograph of uniformed soldiers with backpacks gathering and embracing outdoors, grainy vintage quality, no text.
A painting depicting armed fighters wearing orange headbands with Arabic text, carrying AK-47 rifles.

A rusted abandoned armored vehicle sits on cracked dry lakebed scattered with anti-tank hedgehogs; red flags and women in black walk on the embankment. Watermark "IMNA IMAGES Morteza Salehi" appears bottom right.
A group of Iranian soldiers in green military uniforms and helmets pose outdoors holding rifles under the Iranian flag.
Black-and-white photo of armed soldiers walking through mud, with green Persian text "عملیات مرتضی المقر" overlaid.
